name: What factors affect the durability and longevity of a patio?

mainEntity.name: What factors affect the durability and longevity of a patio?

acceptedAnswer.text: Several factors influence a patio's durability and lifespan, including the quality of materials used, proper installation techniques, and adequate sub-base preparation. High-quality pavers or natural stone, correctly installed with a stable foundation and good compaction, will last significantly longer than a poorly constructed concrete slab. Climate, exposure to heavy foot traffic or vehicles, and regular maintenance also play a role. Proper drainage prevents water damage, and sealing certain materials can protect against stains and weathering, extending the patio's life.
acceptedAnswer.description: Patio durability depends on material quality, proper installation, sub-base preparation, climate, usage, and maintenance. Good drainage and sealing can significantly extend its lifespan.
